normalization: lowercase; retain ASCII alphanumerics/apostrophes; collapse all other characters to word boundaries; report original hypotheses too
decoder: greedy; English; no timestamps; maximum 80 tokens; identical baseline/adapted
adoption_blockers: Only 32 read-speech training clips from one Indian-English speaker
No unseen Indian speaker evaluated; SLT is a US regression control, not an Indian-accent benchmark
Only 16 evaluation utterances; no spontaneous dictation, Hindi/Kannada code-switch, noise, or silence coverage
This compares Whisper before/after, not the production Vosk baseline
Experimental Whisper decoder is not compatible with the existing Vosk app engine
No Android runtime, battery, memory, latency, packaging or physical phone qualification
